text: dsh-qqbot-bridge 是面向 DSH Web 的 QQ 私聊桥接插件，可将 QQ 用户消息送入已有 DS Bot 团队成员的真实 DSH 会话，并把该会话的回复发回 QQ。插件通过 QQ 插件提供的服务接入现有网关，在 DSH 内注册桥接服务；它读取团队状态以选择当前会话，按 QQ OpenID 保存 Bot 路由，并支持切换目标、查看当前 Bot 和团队。适合希望从 QQ 延续 DSH 团队会话的用户。使用前需准备已绑定账户的官方 QQ 机器人和本地扩展版 QQ 插件，并配置允许的 OpenID。

dsh-qqbot-bridge routes QQ private messages into existing DSH team bot sessions and relays their replies through the running QQ bot service. Users can switch bots and persist each sender’s choice. Setup requires a QQ bot, a local plugin fork, DSH session services, and an allowlist.
我想从 QQ 私聊里继续和 DSH 里的团队 Bot 对话。
能把 QQ 消息发到我现有的 DSH 会话，并把回答回传吗？
Let me chat with my existing DSH team bots through QQ private messages.
dsh-qqbot-bridge 的功能「QQ 私聊接入团队会话」：把获准 OpenID 发来的消息提交到当前 Bot 的 DSH 会话，并在该会话完成后将回复关联回 QQ。
dsh-qqbot-bridge 的功能「切换与查看目标 Bot」：在 QQ 消息中使用 Bot 名称切换目标，也可查询当前选择或列出团队；选择按 OpenID 保存，重启后恢复。
dsh-qqbot-bridge 使用前须知：QQ 私聊消息会经已配置的官方 QQ 机器人进入 DSH 会话，回复再经该机器人送回 QQ；插件复用已有 QQ 服务。

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · The problem：You already run a **team of agents** inside DSH: several Bots, each with its own long-lived
session, its own role instructions, its own long-term memory, its own tools and workspace.
You want to talk to them **from QQ**.

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · The problem：The obvious approach — *"write a QQ bot that calls the model with the same system prompt"* —
silently throws away everything that made the team worth building: the conversation history,
the memory files, the permissions, the workspace, the resume-after-restart behaviour.
You end up with a stranger wearing the same name.

This project does not do that. It **delivers a QQ message into the session that Bot already
has**, and relays the Bot's answer back to QQ.

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · What makes it different：| | Typical QQ ⇄ LLM bridge | **dsh-qqbot-bridge** |
|---|---|---|
| Identity | Copies the system prompt | **Reuses the real session** — `sessionController.resolveAgent(sessionId)` then `agent.followup(createUserMessage({ source }))` |
| Context | Starts from scratch | The Bot's actual history, memory, tools and workspace |
| Web ⇄ QQ | Two disconnected worlds | **One session**: start on QQ, continue in the Web UI, same context |
| QQ gateway | Opens its own connection | **Borrows** the one the official plugin already runs — no second login, no credential race |
| Allowlist | `[]` often means *everyone* | `[]` means **nobody** (fail-closed); refused peers are only *recorded*, never auto-granted |
| Observability | Silence when it breaks | Console lines **and** `bridge-status.json` — "did it load?" always has an answer |
| Official commands | Frequently swallowed | `/bot-ping`, `/bot-status`, … keep working |
| Long conversations | Pins one session id | Re-reads `state.json` before every send, so a session that rolls over to a new part keeps working |
| Group chats | Often on by default | Off, and group traffic is handed back to the

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Why a fork of the QQ plugin is required：The stock `@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot` keeps its `QQBot` instance, `SessionManager` and
outbound sender inside local variables and **registers no Cordis service at all**, so an
external plugin cannot send on the same connection, cannot intercept the middleware chain,
and cannot learn which OpenID a message came from. Starting a second gateway with the same
AppID would race the first one for the event stream.

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about：**1. `ctx.set` is not registration.** In Cordis 4, `ctx.provide(name, value)` registers a new
service and returns a disposer; `ctx.set(name, value)` may only *overwrite* a service someone
already provided, and otherwise throws `cannot set property "<name>" without provide`. Both
halves of this project originally used `ctx.set`, which is why the host reported
`2 entries did not activate`. A hand-written fake context with `set = assignment` hid it
perfectly — hence the real-`Context` tests in this repo.
section: Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about

text:
dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about：**2. A declared-but-absent `inject` suspends a plugin in total silence.** The fiber just sits
in `pending`, `apply()` is never called, and the plugin cannot explain itself. So this
plugin declares **no** dependencies at the plugin level, runs `apply()` unconditionally, and
does its waiting with `ctx.inject([...])` plus a watchdog that names every service still
missing.
section: Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about

text:
dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about：**3. …and DSH mounts no console exporter for the Cordis logger.** `LoggerService` installs
exactly one default sink: an in-memory ring buffer. Printing needs
`@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-logger-console`, which no DSH bundle depends on — so in `dsh web`,
`ctx.logger.info(...)` is *invisible*. That is how a perfectly healthy bridge managed to look
like a plugin that had never loaded. Lifecycle facts therefore go to the console directly
(`lib/host-log.js`) and to `<dataDir>/bridge-status.json` (`lib/status.js`). DSH's own e2e
fixtures confirm the contract: their observer has to attach an exporter *and* drain
`ctx.logger.buffer` to see plugin output.
section: Three Cordis/DSH surprises worth reading about

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Diagnostics：`<DSH_HOME>/qqbot-bridge/bridge-status.json` is written the moment `apply()` runs — before the
first message — and holds `phase` (`loading` / `waiting` / `running` / `failed` / `stopped`),
`available`, `transport`, `transportOk`, `allowOpenIdsCount`, `failClosed`, `waitingFor`,
`bots`, timestamps and `lastError`. It contains **counts, never credentials**.

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | What it means |
|---|---|
| Not a single `[qqbot-bridge]` line on startup | Run `node scripts/bridge-status.mjs`. No file ⇒ the bundle was never mounted (check `dsh --profile web --dump-config`). `phase=waiting` ⇒ look at `waitingFor`. `phase=running` ⇒ it is fine; something else is quiet. |
| `cannot set property "qqbot" without provide` | Service registration used `ctx.set`. Cordis 4 needs `ctx.provide` for first registration — regenerate the fork. |
| `2 entries did not activate` | Same cause: neither the gateway nor the bridge started. |
| `warning: 1 entry did not activate` + `pending (waiting for service: …)` | A plugin-level `inject` named a service that never appeared. This bridge declares none. |
| `waiting for service(s): …` and nothing more | One of `sessionController`, `sessions`, `qqbot` is missing; the watchdog repeats it every 10s. |
| `No qqbot service on this host` | The stock QQ plugin is still installed instead of the fork. |
| `qqbot service found but it has no setMessagePreHandler` | The fork is linked but its dependencies were never installed, or it is not the patched build. |

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Security model：* **Fail closed.** An empty `allowOpenIds` refuses every peer.
* **No automatic grants.** A refused OpenID is *written down* (so you can copy it into your
  own config yourself) and nothing else. The bridge never adds itself to the allowlist.
* **No credential handling.** `appSecret` stays in the official plugin's config; the bridge
  owns no socket and opens no connection of its own.
* **Read-only on DS Bot.** `state.json` is read, never written; its lock and atomicity are
  respected.
* **No browser shortcuts.** No `/api/bot`, no forged cookies, no bypassing the Web UI's auth.
* **Credentials are scrubbed from every log line** (`lib/log.js`), and OpenIDs are shortened
  unless `debug` is on.
* `scripts/audit-constraints.mjs` checks all of the above mechanically.

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · Project layout：| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | plugin entry: `name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply` / service waiting + watchdog |
| `lib/host-log.js` | the always-visible console channel |
| `lib/status.js` | writes `<dataDir>/bridge-status.json`, creates the data directory |
| `lib/bridge.js` | ownership verdict, routing, queues, reply correlation, error handling |
| `lib/adapter.js` | the borrowed-gateway transport (and an explicitly failing fallback) |
| `lib/deliver.js` | delivery into the real session, with its own `source` tag |
| `lib/registry.js` | read-only `state.json` parsing, including part rollover |
| `lib/router.js` · `lib/access.js` · `lib/commands.js` | per-OpenID routing, fail-closed allowlist, command parsing |
| `scripts/` | fork generator, profile installer/rollback, status, audit, test runner |
| `patches/` | the fork patch, with the evidence behind every inserted line |

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · 为什么必须给 QQ 插件打一个补丁：官方插件把 `QQBot` 实例、`SessionManager`、出站 `sender` 全部留在函数局部变量里，**没有注册任何 cordis service**，命令注册器用完即弃（见 `patches/0001-qqbot-extension-point.md` 的逐条证据）。因此外部插件：

* 拿不到网关，就无法用同一条连接把文本发回 QQ；
* 插不进中间件，就拦不住原 agent 抢先回答；
* 拿不到「谁发的、回给谁」的 OpenID 映射。

而用同一个 AppID 起第二个网关会与现有连接抢事件流。所以只有两条路：**最小本地 fork**，或在本机做 QQ 协议 MITM 代理。本项目选 fork，且只**新增**两处：

dsh-qqbot-bridge README · 怎么确认「桥接真的加载了」：DSH 没有挂 Cordis 的控制台日志导出器，`ctx.logger` 的输出只会进内存缓冲区
（证据见 `COMPATIBILITY.md` 的「日志通道」一节）。所以桥接的激活状态有**两条**
独立通道，任何一条都足以判断：

1. **终端**：每个生命周期事实都以 `[qqbot-bridge]` 为前缀直接打印；
2. **磁盘**：`<DSH_HOME>/qqbot-bridge/bridge-status.json`，`apply()` 一开始就创建
   目录并写入，不需要等第一条 QQ 消息。

```bash
node scripts/bridge-status.mjs
```

`phase` 的含义：
section: 怎么确认「桥接真的加载了」

text:
dsh-qqbot-bridge README · 怎么确认「桥接真的加载了」：| phase | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `loading` | `apply()` 已进入，正在准备 |
| `waiting` | 插件已加载，但 `waitingFor` 里的服务还没出现（终端每 10s 复述一次） |
| `running` | 桥接已装配，`transport` 是实际使用的传输（正常应为 `dsh-qqbot-bridge/qq`） |
| `failed` | 装配过程中抛错，`lastError` 是原因 |
| `stopped` | 插件已卸载（热重载或退出） |

状态文件里**只有数量，没有任何凭据**：`allowOpenIds` 记数量不记值，`appSecret`
从来不出现。`allowOpenIdsCount: 0` 同时会把 `failClosed` 记为 `true`。

也可以走标准插件安装命令（但 fork 那一步仍需要 `install-profile.mjs`）：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库>
```

section: 怎么确认「桥接真的加载了」

text:
dsh-qqbot-bridge README · 排障：| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 启动日志一行 `[qqbot-bridge]` 都没有 | 先跑 `node scripts/bridge-status.mjs`：文件不存在 = 插件没被加载（查 bundle/patch/`--dump-config`）；文件存在但 `phase=waiting` = 服务没来（看 `waitingFor`）；`phase=running` = 一切正常，只是过去依赖的 `ctx.logger` 在 DSH 里不可见（见 COMPATIBILITY.md「日志通道」） |
| 启动日志 `cannot set property "qqbot" without provide`（或 `"qqbotBridge"`） | 服务注册误用了 `ctx.set`。Cordis 4 里首次注册必须用 `ctx.provide`；重新生成 fork 并确认桥接是最新版本 |
| 启动日志 `2 entries did not activate` | 同上：`im-qqbot` 与 `qqbot-bridge` 都因服务注册失败而未激活 |
| 启动日志 `warning: 1 entry did not activate` + `pending (waiting for service: …)` | 插件级 `inject` 声明了永不出现的服务，Cordis 会静默挂起。本桥接的 `inject` 为空数组，正常情况下不会出现这条 |
| 日志出现 `waiting for service(s): …` 之后没有下文 | 那三个服务里至少一个从没出现；看门狗每 10s 会复述还缺哪些 |
| 日志出现 `No qqbot service on this host` | 官方包没有被 fork 替换。执行安装第 2、3 步 |
| 日志出现 `qqbot service found but it has no setMessagePreHandler` | fork 目录没有生效（依赖没指过去，或没 `pnpm install`） |
| QQ 发消息没反应，且日志有 `refused QQ message` | `allowOpenIds` 没填你的 OpenID，或填错了 |
| 日志有 `queue overflow` | 同一 OpenID 连发超过 `queueMax`（默认 4）条，后面的被丢掉并已提示 |
| Bot 长时间不回 | 到 DSH Web 看那个 Bot 的会话；超过 `replyTimeoutMs` QQ 会收到「请到 DSH Web 查看」 |
